prompt: This exported function takes six positional parameters, two of them booleans; clean it up.
setup: The function is used from several modules inside the same repository.
Nothing states whether the function is part of a published package API.
expected: One or two essential parameters stay positional; the rest move into a single trailing options object with a named readonly-property type.

must_not: Change the function's behavior while reshaping its signature.
Split the overflow into multiple loose config parameters.
